selection: One ocean footprint north of Alaska with all fourteen scan quality flags zero, no land in the file footprint mask, positive three-channel brightness temperatures, and both retrieved ice fractions within [0,1]. A single winter case, not a regional statistic.
tie_points_source: NASA TM-104647 (1997), printed page 14, Table 3, DMSP SSMI F11 ARCTIC. Values already include the listed tuning adjustments.
method: Solve NASA Team polarization/gradient-ratio mixing equations using fixed published F11 tie points. Reapplication to RSS V7 reprocessed swath temperatures, not reproduction of an official NSIDC concentration map. No daily gridding, coastal correction, inter-sensor retuning, or gap filling. The historical 37V/19V GR>0.05 weather screen is evaluated and not triggered. G22 is supplied for inspection but not used as an additional filter.

files.sample.csv: Exact decoded float32 values copied as Python float decimal strings. Geolocation decoded with documented scale 0.01.
files.reproduce.py: Python standard library reconstruction of ratios and linear system.
files.extract.py: Original orbit download, hash check and extraction using h5py.
